name: Olrich
description: A frantic little devil who runs the Mockturne, Kodolaag's friend; he swallows the bloodfray amulet and impersonates Dovin Baan.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag persuades Olrich to host Zita's effigy sales at the Mockturne by promising him an audience at Rix Maadi.
timeline.quote: I'll call in a favor. I'll get you an audience at Rix Maadi!

timeline.summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
timeline.quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing Zita.
timeline.quote: Visit Udzec tomorrow morning. Get in line behind the minotaur with a curly red mane.

timeline.summary: At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet, and Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis by hiding a whiskey bottle in her cape to distract the nullmages.
timeline.quote: Carefully, carefully I rest the bottle inside, hoping it's light enough not to pull the fabric.

timeline.summary: Zita brings a guard's drawing in a coloring book to life, and Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, incapacitating them.
timeline.quote: Electric magic ignites the paper, and the guards wail out in unison as if they're being burned alive.

timeline.summary: Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier, and the trio walks out among exiting visitors.
timeline.quote: Citizens! Behold! It is I, your highly esteemed Grand Arbiter, Protector of Justice, Purveyor of Protocols!

timeline.summary: Jitka Wothis and a vampire identify Kodolaag and Olrich, who are bound by magic; Zita escapes into the crowd.
timeline.quote: Before we can deny it, Olrich and I are bound up in magic.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich are put to forced labor at the Exner prison site.
timeline.quote: As soon as we're given our uniforms, we're put to work with the rest of the non-violent offenders and pre-offenders.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag has Olrich cough up the amulet and scales the Exner scaffolding, shattering the bloodfray stone and triggering a massive riot as archons close in.
timeline.quote: The amulet cracks and unleashes a swarm of black tendrils, pressing the light back and turning day to night.

timeline.summary: Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
timeline.quote: You'll have to set up new lives in the undercity,

relations.quote: that son of a devil who I sometimes dare to call my friend
a hug that lingers long enough for me to wonder about the past shared between them
